prompt:
Create a SINGLE corrected wide panorama target, based on actual screenshot IMAGE1. This is an architectural-site-faithful ENVIRONMENT paintover, not a new fantasy layout. The previous attempt (image3 TOP PANEL) was WRONG in landform topology. Image3 LOWER PANEL has acceptable new-city mountain/forest relationships, use it only as secondary design guidance. Image2 is actual closer view proving the MISSING intermediate mountain mass.
CRITICAL INPUT PRIORITY: Image1 actual overall screenshot defines camera/crop, all buildings/bridges/rail, AND existing mountain volumes. Image2 actual close-up defines middle ridge topology. Image3 is ONLY color/forest/cloud style and lower-panel new-city terrain guidance; do not repeat its incorrect upper panorama geometry.
OUTPUT one wide image approx 2.4:1 matching image1, no second panel. Keep existing buildings' exact identity, silhouettes, scale, relative screen positions and apparent leaning due spherical world: dense LEFT old city with slender stone tower; RIGHT simple large stepped pale fortress with existing dark teal dome/small terracotta roofs; front curving railway, central angular pedestrian bridge and staircases unchanged. Do NOT redesign buildings, enlarge dome, add towers, move foundation or bridge/rail.
PRIMARY CORRECTION A — RESTORE MISSING OLD-CITY RIGHT MOUNTAIN:
Look at IMAGE1 around horizontal 48–58%, vertical48–68%, and IMAGE2 center behind bridge. There is a LARGE BROAD THICK ROCK SHOULDER immediately to the RIGHT of old city's tower/cluster, BEHIND the LEFT HALF of the bridge. Reproduce it as a substantial solid mountain body with a broad crest and a tall continuous front-facing limestone wall descending into the shared mountain foot. Its top crest sits below the high old-town rear mountain but is clearly much higher than bridge deck. It must not disappear into trees, clouds or tiny pointed boulders. The topology from old city to right is: old-city short rear ridge -> lower connecting shoulder -> ONE WIDE SOLID INTERMEDIATE MOUNTAIN MASS -> a distinct low saddle -> taller right-side secondary peak. Keep the actual existing valley opening, do not fill all saddles into a wall. This middle mountain must be one of the clearest shapes in the picture, with bare rock faces showing its volume.
PRIMARY CORRECTION B — NEW-CITY SUPPORTING MOUNTAIN:
Right domed fortress must sit on ONE coherent thick attached bedrock mass that descends from rear rock shoulder to castle foundations and then down to exposed coastal cliff. Establish broad stable shoulders and 2–3 actual soil-bearing ledges on this body, continuing around side/back like LOWER PANEL of image3. Grass and grey-teal forest should attach to these sloped shelves; not isolated rock spikes crammed under bridge or decorative green edging on walls. A visible natural foothill should appear BELOW and to LEFT/RIGHT of castle foundation, but never extend across central bay or obstruct pedestrian bridge landing, stairs, entrances, plaza or railway envelope. No floating castle, no roots in water, no green on masonry roofs. Preserve all real circulation dimensions and recognizable coast arrangement from IMAGE1; terrain improvements are within existing natural footprint.
STYLE: use Oskar-inspired 2024 experiment broad matte simple colour fields as in image3: desaturated grey-teal connected rounded forest crowns, pale sage/yellow-green grass, pale warm limestone lit planes with cool grey shadows. Fine organic grass/rock transitions. Broad readable cliffs, not noisy tessellation, chipped rock texture or scattered broccoli dots. Plant mainly soil-bearing ledges/shoulders. Expose most vertical rock and keep the critical intermediate mountain face clearly visible. This is not a photoreal miniature.
WATER: muted PALE GREY-CYAN sea/harbour with soft darker bridge shadows and narrow broken milky-white rock-edge foam. No navy sea, no bright turquoise. Maintain clear coast and bridge underpass water.
CLOUDS: because missing landform is the issue, use ONLY TWO SPARSE LOW BROKEN BANKS around FAR/BACK mountain shoulders. White rounded connected bodies with cool grey underside, occluded behind rock then reappearing beside it. They indicate mountain wrapping but DO NOT obscure the intermediate broad mountain, saddle, new-city base, architecture or transport. No blanket cloud background and no cloud in every gap. Mountains need to be structurally readable without cloud camouflage.
Caption small at top left “高山圣城 · 全景地势修正”; bottom “概念示意 · 建筑保留现状”. No other text. Prioritize actual topology and fixed current architecture over beautification. Single panorama only, faithful existing-camera view with restored intermediate mountain and logically continuous new-city natural support.
